title: WPSS/1157/2023 of SASHI YADAV Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS NO.1157 of 2023
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
2. Mr. P.C. Bisht, learned Additional C.S.C.
for the State.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner
undertakes to remove the defects by fixing a
coupon, which is pointed out by the Registry,
as defect in the matter.
5. By means of this writ petition,
petitioner has challenged the impugned
transfer order dated 26.06.2023, annexure5
to the writ petition, whereby petitioner has
been transferred from Government Girls
Higher Secondary School, Dabhoura,
Mustakam, Block Kashipur, District U.S.
Nagar to Government Girls Inter College,
Bharsoli, District Almora
5. The main challenge of the impugned
order by the petitioner is on the ground that
petitioner was transferred to the present
place of posting only on 21.07.2022 and she
joined barely nine months ago.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that her husband is posted in
nearby school and she was transferred there
only under the spouse policy as per the
provisions of the Uttarakhand Annual
Transfer for Public Servant Act, 2017 (for

2
short "the Act") and now without application
of mind, petitioner has been transferred
under the compulsory transfer from the
present place of posting at a distinct place,
which is a remote area.
7. Per contra, learned State Counsel
submitted that transfer is an exigency of
service and incidental to her service. She has
already served in the sugam area for a
period of 10 years almost, therefore, she was
transferred.
8. Be that as it may. Having heard the
learned counsel for the parties, it appears
from the impugned transfer order that the
respondent authorities have not considered
the fact that the petitioner is posted at the
present place of posting barely nine months
ago and, therefore, transfer order appears to
be harassment to the petitioner.
9. In this view of the matter, the writ
petition is disposed of by directing petitioner
to move a representation to the Director
Secondary Education within a period of one
week from the date of certified copy of this
order, who shall decide it by speaking order
within a period of three weeks' from the date
of receipt of representation. Till then, the
impugned transfer order shall remain stayed
qua the petitioner.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 10.07.2023
AK
